description_en: Publicly known USB vendor IDs of software-protection dongle makers, and where each maker's own official runtime lives. Used by scripts/dongle.py to recognise a physical dongle that the owner plugged in (USB pass-through) and to check that the maker's runtime is installed and running. Only vendor/product IDs and the readable manufacturer/product strings are used; serial numbers or any other unique identifier are never read. Nothing here emulates or answers a dongle. RavenGun does not ship, download or install any maker software. A vendor without a runtime entry is reported as 'dongle found, runtime unknown'.

sentinel-ldk.name: Sentinel LDK Runtime (Thales)
sentinel-ldk.install_hint_en: Install the official Sentinel LDK Runtime for Linux from Thales (the aksusbd and hasplmd daemons; the License Manager listens on localhost:1947).

codemeter.name: CodeMeter Runtime (Wibu-Systems)
codemeter.install_hint_en: Install the official CodeMeter Runtime for Linux from Wibu-Systems (the CodeMeterLin service).
